capture_rule: Capture every byte and every compound, citation, dataset, property, variable, constraint, phase, method, uncertainty and point from each complete NIST ThermoML source. Construct the empirical vector from every direct-value thermal-conductivity property point in those sources. Preserve every non-thermal-conductivity companion property and dataset but exclude it from thermal-conductivity measurements. Do not select substances, mixtures, phases, compositions, temperatures, pressures, methods, datasets, properties or rows within a source.
source_selection_boundary: The three complete authoritative sources are fixed before any thermal-conductivity value, uncertainty or target hash is captured and before executable-law registration, candidate enumeration or prediction-program construction. Coverage is fixed structurally: pure, binary and ternary chemical systems; gas, liquid and crystalline phases; composition, temperature and pressure carriers; and independently named measurement methods. No observed result value selects a source or row.
